brief: Ukraine's banking/payments event and award landscape is small, concentrated in Kyiv, and organised around four hubs that between them produce nearly all the dated title data in this cell: the ЄМА association (26 editions of Payments & Security, with a full conference archive), the UAFIC fintech association (Pay.Forum, UAFIN.TECH, Digital Lending, Ukraine Fintech Week), the banking association NABU (Fintech & Payments Forum, corporate-directors forum, training centre), and the media-run award franchises — FinAwards (Мінфін/Finance.ua), whose jury explicitly includes the board chairs of the 17 largest banks, and the competing «Банк(и) року» rankings from Фінансовий клуб and МФК «БАНКИРЪ». Forbes Ukraine's Forbes Banker and the Kyiv International Economic Forum add a cross-sector layer, and KIEF is the only source found with a clean multi-year per-edition speaker directory URL pattern; cfo.ua's cumulative «Всі спікери» page is the cheapest single bulk extraction target. Executive education (KSE, kmbs) is a real but slower actor layer — kmbs's Master in Banking and Finance is the only banking-specific programme identified, while KSE offers general executive programmes only.
